a: Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record, Readonly are common utility types.
Discriminated unions use a shared tag field for safe narrowing.
Type guards (is/asserts) narrow types in control flow.
T extends U ? X : Y enables type-level branching.
Mapped types transform each property of a type programmatically.
Template literal types build string types from parts.
satisfies checks a value matches a type without widening inference.
unknown is safe until narrowed; any disables checking.
strictNullChecks makes null/undefined explicit in the type system.
.d.ts files describe types for JS libraries.
